theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_bti_rescaled_tests_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ j, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μs j K < ∞) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, g x ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂μ))) → Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 1) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ y, f (s j • y) ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
